styleAnswer.evidence: The asphalt patches are large areas of one charcoal grey, with only two close base greys, a few pale worn blobs, sparse 1-pixel flecks and thin cracks. That is about 3 steps on the main material, against roughly 5-6 for Beodeul. The brief asks for smooth, flat asphalt, but the standard is the craft bar, so the flatness and shallow ramp still count against it.
